title: Kitchen Safety and Planning Your Day
subject: money

sections.body: KITCHEN SAFETY: wash hands, ask an adult before using knives or the stove, turn pan handles inward, and use oven gloves.
Simple no-cook recipes to start: sandwiches, fruit salad, yoghurt with fruit.
PLANNING YOUR DAY: list what you must do (homework, chores), what you'd like to do (play, read), and give each a time.
Write a plan for tomorrow after school. Did you stick to it?

quiz.q: Why turn pan handles inward on the stove?
options: So nobody knocks the pan over
hints: What could happen if a handle sticks out?
Someone walking past could bump it.
We push chairs in so people don't trip. Pan handles go in for a similar reason.
quiz.explain: So nobody bumps the handle and spills hot food.

quiz.q: What's a good first step in planning your afternoon?
options: List what you must do and what you'd like to do
hints: Before a trip you make a list of things to pack. Planning a day starts the same way.
quiz.explain: List your must-dos and want-to-dos, then give each a time.
